title: Earliest Skinwalker UFO images kept with full metadata

tellings.quote: even the earliest UFO images that were captured above Skinwalker Ranch under my stewardship, I have the metadata.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long known for reports of strange lights and events, says he has kept the full metadata for every UFO image taken over the ranch since he took charge, even the very first ones. Metadata is the hidden file data that records when, where and on what device a picture was taken. He tells Michels this to say the photos can be checked rather than taken on trust.
